newsitem.title: UK: Bk of Scotland underperforms after results.
newsitem.headline: Bk of Scotland underperforms after results.

text.p: Shares in Bank of Scotland were underperfroming other financials on Wednesday morning despite the bank's better than expected pretax profits.
"Although the figures are higher than forecast there was a major contribution from securities gains which means the quality of the profits is poor," a banking analyst at a European bank said.
Bank of Scotland shares were up 0.5 pence at 337p by 0920 GMT on volume of 1.6 million.
The Royal Bank of Scotland was up 10.5p at 561p while Barclays Bank was up 20p at 1053p.
Bank of Scotland posted a 22 percent rise in pre-tax profits for the year to the end of February.
Pre-tax profits rose to 664.1 million stg (1.1 billion) compared to 545 million stg in the previous year while total dividend jumped 20 percent to 8.22p per share from 6.85p per share last time.
Bank of Scotland Governor Sir Bruce Pattullo said the rise in profits was based on the "ongoing development of the scope and professionalism of its businesses".
